# Build-time dependencies for publish-pypi.yml.
#
# Pinned with --require-hashes for supply-chain safety (REQ-NF-004).
# Used only inside the publish-pypi workflow; not a runtime dependency
# of neo4j-cli itself.
#
# go-to-wheel: wraps a Go binary into a Python wheel. We import its
# build_wheel() helper directly (skipping the CLI entry point) so we can
# feed pre-built GoReleaser binaries instead of cross-compiling from source.

    --hash=sha256:efc6c9b8b1ea6074cc2679820b5b5d47197ef9172e1169fb332caab5ebbf62c0
